description.en: An example extension built only on cmux-extension-sdk: your own agent picks the ads, banners, popups and sticky bars on a web page, and cmux hides them on that site from then on.

scopes.browser:read: Read the address of the page you're looking at, to know which site to clean.
scopes.browser:execute: Run a script that lists the elements on the page that look like clutter, when you run the command. It changes nothing.
scopes.browser:write: Hide the elements your agent picked on that site, and put them back when you click Restore.
scopes.agent:execute: Ask your default agent which elements are clutter, once each time you run the command.
scopes.storage:local: Remember which sites you cleaned on this Mac, for the Sites cleaned list.
